about_short_description.short_description: AquaShield is curious and solution-minded, innovating good clean water.

product.name: Aqua-Ponic™ Biofiltration System
product.description: A modular biofiltration system combining filtration with hydroponic plant growth to treat stormwater runoff and support vegetation sustainability.

product.name: Aqua-Swirl® Stormwater Treatment System
product.description: A hydrodynamic separator that removes coarse sediment, debris, and free-floating oil from stormwater using a gravity-driven swirl chamber without moving parts.

product.name: Aqua-Filter™ Stormwater Filtration System
product.description: A filtration system that captures and removes sediment, oil, and floatable pollutants from stormwater runoff using replaceable filter media containers.
